title: Conflicted Records: Typed Adversarial Contracts for Auditable LLM Output Quality Enforcement
abstract: arXiv:2610.29669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-generated records increasingly populate production information systems where they are treated as data assets subject to the same quality expectations as records from operational databases. A single such record can simultaneously satisfy and violate a quality rule: a grounded fact adjacent to a hallucination, a useful answer adjacent to a stereotype. Classical data cleaning cannot resolve this because the two judgments are incompatible over the same span; a single LLM judge cannot either, since it shares the training biases that produced the conflict. Existing interventions such as prompt engineering, chain-of-thought, and RLHF reduce surface error rates but provide no audit trail and cannot distinguish genuine remediation from blanket suppression. translated_title: 冲突记录：用于可审计 LLM 输出质量强制的类型化对抗契约
translated_abstract: LLM 生成的记录日益充斥于生产信息系统中，并在其中被视为数据资产，需要满足与操作数据库记录相同的质量期望。然而，单条这样的记录可能同时满足又违反某条质量规则：一个有据可查的事实旁可能是幻觉，一个有用的回答旁可能是刻板印象。经典的数据清洗方法无法解决这一问题，因为这两种判断在同一文本片段上互不兼容；单一的 LLM 评判者也无能为力，因为它与产生该冲突的训练偏差同源。诸如提示工程、思维链和 RLHF 等现有干预手段虽能降低表面错误率，但既无法提供审计轨迹，也无法区分真正的修复与一刀切的压制。因此问题在于：对结构化的智能体间记录进行确定性检查，能否捕获仅凭参照性检查所遗漏的缺陷。我们提出了 BiasGuard-D：两个对抗性角色……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 BiasGuard-D，通过两个类型化对抗契约角色对结构化智能体间记录执行确定性检查，实现对 LLM 输出质量的可审计强制执行，捕获单一 LLM 评判者与传统数据清洗都无法发现的冲突性缺陷。
en_tdlr: Proposes BiasGuard-D, which uses two typed adversarial contract roles performing deterministic checks over structured inter-agent records to auditably enforce LLM output quality, catching conflicting defects that a single LLM judge and classical data cleaning miss.
